base_text: You are trying to solve a difficult math problem on a whiteboard. A classmate walks up.

variants.warm: They point out a small error in your equation and help you correct it.
variants.cold: They erase a section of the board to write their own problem without speaking.
variants.adversarial: They point at your work and say a child could solve it much faster.
variants.neutral: They read the equation on the board, nod to themselves, and walk away.

base_text: You find an interesting historical artifact in the museum and point it out.

variants.warm: The person next to you reads the plaque aloud and shares a related historical fact.
variants.cold: The person ignores your gesture and continues looking at their phone screen.
variants.adversarial: The person shakes their head and claims the artifact is an obvious modern forgery.
variants.neutral: The person glances at the display case and moves to the next museum exhibit.

base_text: You are learning to play a new song on the guitar in the park. Someone stops to listen.

variants.warm: They comment on your progress and share a tip for transitioning between chords.
variants.cold: They put in their earplugs and sit on a bench facing away from you.
variants.adversarial: They cover their ears and loudly tell you that you are entirely out of tune.
variants.neutral: They listen for a minute, check their phone, and continue their morning walk.

base_text: You are attempting to use a new software tool for the first time. A colleague is nearby.

variants.warm: They pull up a chair and walk you through the basic features step by step.
variants.cold: They glance at your screen and return to their own work without offering assistance.
variants.adversarial: They tell you that you are wasting time and should have read the manual.
variants.neutral: They suggest checking the online documentation if you run into any further issues.

base_text: You discover a hidden trail in the woods and point it out to a fellow hiker.

variants.warm: They express genuine interest and suggest exploring the path together right now.
variants.cold: They ignore the trail and keep walking on the main path without a backward glance.
variants.adversarial: They scold you for wandering off the marked path and breaking park rules.
variants.neutral: They look down the hidden trail, adjust their backpack, and continue walking.
